investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Caldgate Mobility (ride-hailing); Platform: AWS eu-west-1 (zones eu-west-1a/eu-west-1b/eu-west-1c); network range 10.106.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster caldga-prod-euwest (EKS); Billing: a daily charge job 'subscription-renewals' is triggered by the in-house scheduler 'chronos-lite', which computes run times from local wall-clock time (Europe/London); charges go through payment-gw to an external card processor; job executions are recorded by job name; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
